title: 2027 Hiking Planner Printable, Hike a Week Challenge, Miles Hiked Tracker, Hiking Goals, Gift for Hiker, Stocking Stuffer, Hiking Calendar
description:
Make 2027 your best year on the trail. This 28-page printable planner helps you set your hiking goals, plan a hike for every month, take the Hike-a-Week Challenge and color in every mile. It comes with a gift page and cut-out gift tags, so it is an easy holiday gift or stocking stuffer for the hiker in your life.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Gift page with space for your note and two cut-out gift tags
- How to use the planner, and a 2027 hiking goals page: distance, number of hikes, new trails, your big hike of the year and a skill to learn
- 2027 at a glance with US and Canadian long weekends marked
- 12 monthly calendars (Sunday start) with US federal and Canadian holidays, a list of hikes you plan, a monthly total and a seasonal tip (ice season, mud season, tick checks, afternoon storms, hunting seasons, early dark and more)
- The Hike-a-Week Challenge: 52 boxes, one for every week
- Color-in posters: 100 miles, 250 km and 12 summits or viewpoints
- Bucket list of 20 trails, a big trip planner, a gear wish list and season check
- Quarterly look-back pages and a year in review
- Dates to look up for 2027 (fee-free park days, reservation windows and more), with where to check them

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Room for miles or kilometers, for hikers in the US and Canada. Seasonal tips are general: always check the park or forest website and the weather before every hike. Fee-free park days for 2027 were not announced when we made it, so the planner tells you where to check instead of guessing. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
